_doc: Head-phantom geometry for the API source mode — CsI ring at 2 radiation lengths. Mid-bore variant: crystal r_inner 300 mm (patient aperture ~50 cm after cryostat), 37 phi-blocks (50.9 mm arc) x 10 wheels = 512 mm axial; same block technology and detector constants (r_inner, n_phi, n_z, half_length); wall = 2 X0 of CsI (X0 = 1.860 cm -> 3.720 cm; the CRYSP 3.5 mm FWHM position resolution is measured on 2X0 crystals). The phantom section is a PLACEHOLDER — in mode="api" the driver replaces it with the phantom built from the scenario's phantom_regions.csv. Dimensions in cm; material keys into data/materials.json.
